text:
release_manager: Heads-up — we swapped model variant in canary ~10m ago (v2.4.1 -> v3.0.0-quant). Seeing p95 drift on US-W latency. Change window starts in ~40m.

deploybot: [deploy] Canary 3.0.0-quant rolled to 20% at 2026-03-20T22:05Z. No rollout blocks flagged.

alina: Noted. What's the p95 delta? current vs baseline?

jasper: baseline p95 ~120ms, canary showing ~240ms for a subset of requests (token-heavy prompts). Error rates fine, just latency.

ops_lead: Given this is inside the change window, prefer soft rollback (traffic-slice rollback to v2.4.1) rather than full revert. Minimize churn for Dedicated customers.

maria: If we do soft rollback, I'll patch release notes and customer status page with "temporary traffic rollback for performance investigation". Drafting copy now.

alina: Criteria proposal: auto fallback if p95 > 2x baseline for two consecutive 5-min windows OR manual rollback if error rate > 0.5% AND latency > 1.5x baseline. Thoughts?

jasper: Fine, but add a region clause — only roll back US-W traffic slice if EU metrics stable. We don't want global rollback for region glitch.

samir: I'll run the soft rollback once we agree. Runbook snippet:
```
# pin traffic slice back to v2.4.1
redwoodctl rollout update --model v2.4.1 --slice us-west --traffic 20%
# monitor p95 for 10m
```

ops_lead: +1. Put manual hold for auto-rollbacks for this change window (we don't want deploybot to auto-cutover until ops ack).

release_manager: Agreed. ops_lead take control of the hold. samir, stand by for go. maria, send internal note to CSMs after we execute.

deploybot: [deploybot] Auto-rollback disabled for release 3.0.0-quant (hold set by ops_lead).

samir: Executing soft rollback to v2.4.1 for us-west slice now. Will post status in 5m.

deploybot: [deploy] Traffic re-assigned: us-west slice -> v2.4.1 (20%) at 2026-03-20T22:18Z.

samir: Early numbers: p95 down to ~130ms after switch. Still watching tail.

maria: Internal note sent to CSMs: "We've temporarily routed a portion of US-West traffic back to v2.4.1 while we investigate latency with v3.0.0-quant. No customer data exposure. We will update once root cause identified."

alina: Filing an eval run to compare KV cache behavior and kernel selection for long-token prompts. tagging infra-ml.

release_manager: Thanks team. We'll keep the change window open and only re-roll forward after root cause + perf regression test.
